## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Barcelona, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 10 km. It starts at Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya, Palau Nacional, Sants-Montjuïc, 08038 Barcelona, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embrace the spirit of Barcelona with this in-depth self-guided audio tour, ideal for art aficionados and history buffs alike. Your exploration includes your ticket to the Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya, paving the way for a cultural journey through the city's storied streets.
>
> Note! An audio guide inside the Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya isn't included within this bundle – a free app is available at the museum.
>
> Feel the echoes of the past as you traverse the route starting from the majestic hill of Montjuïc, where you'll revel in the museum's art and breathtaking views, and ending at Gaudí's magnum opus, La Sagrada Família.
>
> Walk through the narrative-rich arteries of the Gothic Quarter and marvel at Modernist masterpieces like La Pedrera and Casa Batlló along the Passeig de Gràcia. Witness, and unwind in the serenity of squares like Sant Felip Neri and engross yourself in the exceptional details that characterize Barcelona. Learn about the historic maritime homage of Santa Maria del Mar and the Columbus Monument.
